NONE: › abbreviation for General Equivalency Diploma: an official document in the US that is given to someone who did not complete high school (= school for students aged 15–18) but who has passed a government exam instead
（美國）普通教育發展證書（general equivalency diploma的縮寫）
› used at the end of saying something in order to attract attention to a joke that has been made with two meanings of a word
（在説過一個雙關語的笑話後，用以提醒聽者）明白了嗎？聽出來了嗎?

example: The new series of plays on Channel Four is called 4-Play. Geddit?
「第四頻道的新連續劇叫做 4-Play，明白了麼？」
